vacancy.title: Lead End-to-End Performance Engineer
vacancy.assessment: Direct ESA A2-A4 ESTEC role on SAGA QKD mission; interdisciplinary requirements, performance budgets, verification, industrial coordination and team leadership match general systems and technical project ambitions. Specialist space mission/optical QKD experience is a significant stretch. Minimum 4 years relevant professional experience; ESA may appoint at A1 when post-MSc experience is limited.
